source.rationale: AND-mode, one product (not typed exactly) and one inbound_shipment. Both resolve, but the emitted ORDER is non-products first — compatible_entities is rebuilt from exact_entities, it is not the input order. Routing then keys on the PRODUCT rows only: routing_company is the product's company, not the shipment's, even though both carry one. SUPERSEDED ON THE CLONE (exec 13743718, 2026-08-24): the routing axis is now EVERY compatible row that carries a company_id, products and customers alike, minus brand/category - the same set not-found-error-message's `_searchedCos` claims to have searched, because a reply that says "checked in Mocha and Sorento" and then offers one company's team is a contradiction the customer reads. This fixture still pins the LIVE body, which keeps the products-first filter until the hunk is promoted. AT PROMOTION THIS EXPECTED VALUE CHANGES: both c1 (product) and c2 (inbound_shipment) become routing_companies and routing_company goes null. Re-pin it with the promotion, do not delete it - it is the record of the reversal. plan case F (2026-08-24): routing_companies entries also carry `labels[]` - the customer-facing name for each routing subject (display name for a customer, canonical_code for a product), so a debtor code like 300-D059 never has to stand in for an account in a reply. Additive; `codes` is untouched and nothing on this spine reads `labels` yet.
